tools.description: Stop CPU sampling for this tab and copy the .cpuprofile to the server.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Read a CPU profile from this tab and list sampled hot functions. Self time is sampled, not an exact measurement.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture this tab's JavaScript heap, compress it, and copy it to the server. Can briefly pause the page. Maximum compressed transfer is 5 MiB.

tools.name: summary
tools.description: Summarize a retained heap snapshot from this tab by class and shallow bytes. Shallow size is not retained size; one snapshot does not prove a leak.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Find heap objects by a literal case-insensitive name substring, with bounded results ordered by shallow size.

tools.name: object
tools.description: Inspect one exact object ID returned by heap.query, including bounded outgoing references and retainers. IDs belong to that snapshot.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare two snapshots from this tab by class counts and shallow bytes. Positive deltas mean growth, not proof of a leak.

tools.name: lighthouse
tools.description: Audit the current tab with Lighthouse for accessibility, SEO and best practices. Does not emulate a device or run a performance benchmark. Returns scores and server-local reports.
